nodes.name: ru.ts
nodes.summary: Russian translation dictionary exporting the `dict` string table that backs the ru locale for every UI surface in the app.

nodes.name: th.ts
nodes.summary: Thai translation dictionary exporting the `dict` string table that backs the th locale for the app UI.

nodes.name: tr.ts
nodes.summary: Turkish translation dictionary exporting the `dict` string table for the tr locale, keyed to match the English dictionary's keys.
nodes.languageNotes: Imports `dict as en` from en.ts solely for typing (`type Keys = keyof typeof en`), so missing translations surface as type errors.

nodes.name: zh.ts
nodes.summary: Simplified Chinese translation dictionary exporting the `dict` string table for the zh locale, keyed to match the English dictionary.

nodes.name: zht.ts
nodes.summary: Traditional Chinese translation dictionary exporting the `dict` string table for the zht locale, keyed to match the English dictionary.

nodes.name: index.css
nodes.summary: Global stylesheet importing the shared Tailwind layer from @opencode-ai/ui, registering the JetBrainsMono Nerd Font face, and defining component-level CSS: the session-progress whip animation, getting-started container queries, and fade-in keyframes.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses `@layer components` with data-attribute selectors and CSS container queries (`@container getting-started`) for layout adaptation.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Public API barrel for the app package, re-exporting app providers (AppBaseProviders, PlatformProvider, ServerConnection), file-picker constants, command and locale hooks, and notification-click handling.

nodes.name: directory-layout.tsx
nodes.summary: Route layout for /:dir URLs that decodes the base64 directory parameter, redirects with an error toast when invalid, and mounts SDK/Sync providers plus a directory-scoped DataProvider for child routes.

nodes.name: DirectoryDataProvider
nodes.summary: Wraps children in a directory-scoped DataProvider and LocalProvider, keeps the URL slug in sync when the sync layer reports a different directory, and triggers session sync for the route's session id.

nodes.name: Layout
nodes.summary: Default-exported route layout: resolves the base64 :dir param, shows an error toast and navigates home when it cannot be decoded, and renders SDKProvider/SyncProvider/DirectoryDataProvider once resolved.

nodes.name: error.tsx
nodes.summary: App-level error boundary page: recursively formats error and cause chains into readable localized text, special-cases SDK init errors, and offers check-for-updates / install-update recovery actions.

nodes.name: safeJson
nodes.summary: Safely serializes an unknown value to JSON, falling back to a localized placeholder when the value is circular or not serializable.

nodes.name: formatInitError
nodes.summary: Formats structured SDK/server initialization errors into localized multiline messages, branching on error kind to extract status, URL, and response details.

nodes.name: formatErrorChain
nodes.summary: Recursively formats an error plus its `cause` chain, deduplicating repeated messages and stack headers and joining segments with a localized 'caused by' separator.

nodes.name: ErrorPage
nodes.summary: Exported full-screen error page component that renders the formatted error chain and exposes check-for-update and update-and-restart recovery actions via the platform layer.

nodes.name: home.tsx
nodes.summary: Landing page shown outside any project: logo, server health indicator with server-switcher dialog, five most recently updated projects, and open-project flows using the native directory picker or a fallback dialog.

nodes.name: Home
nodes.summary: Default-exported Home component computing recent projects from global sync data, switching between recent-projects, loading, and empty states, and opening selected directories via the layout project registry.

nodes.name: layout.tsx
nodes.summary: The main authenticated app shell: a single ~2,400-line Layout component rendering the drag-sortable project/workspace sidebar, per-directory session prefetch queues with concurrency limits, opencode:// deep-link handling, inline rename editing, notification sounds, command palette wiring, theme/titlebar/debug overlays, and resize handles.
nodes.languageNotes: One giant SolidJS component owns global app state via ~90 imports; the prefetch-queue lifecycle and sidebar subtrees are extracted into sibling modules under pages/layout/ for testability.

nodes.name: Layout
nodes.summary: Default-exported app shell component orchestrating workspace/session sidebar state (DnD ordering, hover previews, inline renames), session prefetch scheduling through createPrefetchQueues, deep-link draining, permission/notification/sound effects, global commands, and the Titlebar/SidebarContent/DebugBar composition.

nodes.name: AGENTS.md
nodes.summary: Agent instructions documenting the prefetch-queue lifecycle invariants: cleanup must run in the prefetch finally block (not only the reactive effect), and queue state lives in prefetch-queue.ts so it stays unit-testable without mounting the Layout component.

nodes.name: deep-links.ts
nodes.summary: Pure helpers for opencode:// deep links: parsing open-project and new-session URLs (with optional prompt), bulk-collecting valid links from URL lists, and draining pending links stashed on the window object.

nodes.name: parseDeepLink
nodes.summary: Parses an opencode://open-project URL and returns its directory parameter, or undefined for any other host or missing directory.

nodes.name: parseNewSessionDeepLink
nodes.summary: Parses an opencode://new-session URL, returning the target directory and optional prompt text, or undefined when the link is invalid.

nodes.name: collectOpenProjectDeepLinks
nodes.summary: Maps a list of URLs through parseDeepLink and filters out invalid entries, yielding the directories to open.

nodes.name: collectNewSessionDeepLinks
nodes.summary: Maps a list of URLs through parseNewSessionDeepLink and filters out invalid entries, yielding new-session targets with optional prompts.

nodes.name: drainPendingDeepLinks
nodes.summary: Atomically drains and clears the pending deep-link list stashed on window.__OPENCODE__ so each link is handled exactly once.
